configuration.gate: pre-staged batch, eligible two seconds after staging; startup must finish before eligibility
configuration.measurement: completion event wall time minus shared queue eligibility; excludes admission/startup
configuration.warmup: one mixed batch per worker count at seed0; excluded
configuration.order: rotate 1/4-worker order by seed index plus timing repetition; clean then mixed
configuration.limitations: single host; controlled faults; wall-clock adjustments unmodeled; finite independent lockers; not fleet capacity
